canonicalCommitSemantics: The commit containing this file is the canonical documentation synchronization commit. evidenceHeadBeforeSync is intentionally the last technical evidence HEAD before this atomic sync and is not a self-reference.

phaseA.progressRule: I3 integral PASS moves formal progress directly from 35 to 60; no invented fractional formal percentage. Operational progress is reported separately.

nextAuthorizedShape.purpose: Focal provider identity-link read-only adjudication only

recoveryPlan: Synchronize and machine-check canonical source truth before any technical/provider action.
Execute one focal read-only identity-link adjudication and classify the target link as deleted, deactivated, re-scoped, mutated, or intact-but-nonapplicable.
If a correctable provider-state drift is proven, request one exact write gate, apply only the canonical correction, read back immediately, and close I3 on the same state.
Require shp-57d2e3769946 to resolve to TYA_GT_0C0BA8856E with 2 August visits canonical and 0 residual before I3 PASS.
Move immediately into I4 visible operational slices after I3 integral PASS.
Complete I5 build lock, preproduction, rollback, same-build E2E, explicit production authorization, cutover and smoke.
Continue post-production evolution under the same atomic source-truth and anti-loop protocol.

sourceTruthProtocol.historyLayer: Dated source locks, addenda, evidence and prior checkpoints remain audit history only unless the canonical index explicitly activates them.
sourceTruthProtocol.atomicGateClose: A provider/runtime gate is not continuable as closed until evidence, execution state, index, source lock, checkpoint, CAMBIOS, RESUMEN, PENDIENTES and PR summary are synchronized to one syncEpoch.
sourceTruthProtocol.repeatCircuitBreaker: The same blocker may not be retried a third time without narrowed new evidence. Two non-narrowing repetitions trigger FORENSIC_STOP.

productArchitecture.platformGoal: Commercializable multi-tenant no-code field operations and mystery shopping platform
productArchitecture.hardcodingRule: TyA and Cinepolis are validation instances, never global product logic.
productArchitecture.newProjectOnboardingTarget: configure source -> map -> dry-run -> validate -> activate
productArchitecture.identityRule: Use tenantId, projectId, visitId/hrRowId, shopperId and exact crosswalks; never deduplicate by visual/name/email similarity alone.
productArchitecture.frontendBoundary: Backend defines reusable contracts/adapters. No-code Project Builder and UI changes are documented for Claude/prototype by file/module and acceptance criteria; backend does not silently patch modules.
productArchitecture.academiaBoundary: Manuals, courses, role routes and notifications evolve with tenant/project configuration and are versioned with the operational product.

environments.postProductionProtocol: Same canonical state, atomic close and machine verifier continue after go-live.
